12.t: Working with data: discoveries over time
q: In which period were the most discoveries recorded?
How many more discoveries were recorded in 1600-1799 than in 1400-1599?
Describe the pattern shown by the bar chart.
Few discoveries until 1600, then the number rises quickly, more than doubling from 1600-1799 to 1800-1999.
Suggest two reasons for the pattern, and one reason why the book may not show all discoveries.

New instruments (telescope, microscope) and printing let ideas spread; more people worked as scientists. The book may leave out discoveries from some cultures or ones not written down in its language, so early periods may look emptier than they were.
